observations.summary: Taiwan's defense ministry reported tracking two Russian military aircraft entering its air-defense identification zone from the northeast early November 17 and exiting south of Taitung. Japan separately protested a reported Russian airspace violation near Okinoshima. Whether the two reports involve the same aircraft or coordinated activity is unverified. An ADIZ entry is not itself a territorial airspace violation.
observations.title: Taiwan reports two Russian military aircraft crossing eastern ADIZ
